description: List loyalty-program customers, newest first, with their points balance, state and VIP tier id. Look a customer up by exact email, or filter by state or last-updated time. Cursor-paginated (metadata.next_cursor). Smile: GET /customers.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous response's metadata.next_cursor (or previous_cursor). Omit for the first page.

email.description: Exact email address to look up.

state.description: candidate = not yet joined, member = in the program, disabled = excluded.

updated_at_min.description: Only records updated at/after this ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.
